PR Summary by Qodo

Add a collapsible desktop sidebar and improve UI contrast ✨ Enhancement 🧪 Tests 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add localized sidebar labels and persistent collapse controls without a toggle button.
>• Improve text contrast and introduce choice cards for subscription auto-update presets.
>• Give proxy cards more room and test sidebar interactions.
>
Merge Risk 🟢 Low

Blast radius 🔴 High 💥 4 capabilities

- 4 affected capabilities span independent functional scopes: desktop_navigation_shell, desktop_visual_theme_system, proxy_management, subscription_management. - The changed path starts at the shared sidebar DOM, is initialized from main.js, and affects navigation labels, page selection affordances, width, overlay, and tooltip presentation as one bounded desktop navigation-shell behavior. - The navigation module remains the consumer of data-nav buttons; no separate backend or persistent business capability is reached. - This path is a distinct user operation: choosing and saving the refresh interval for a subscription. - It is not merely a navigation or styling hop; the selected data-value is consumed by the subscription edit save handler. - The changed selector applies specifically to the proxy-list grid and changes only how proxy records are laid out for scanning; it does not alter proxy selection, core configuration, or network traffic. - The changed token definitions and global selectors are a bounded cross-page visual-theme integration. - They reach many existing page consumers through shared CSS variables, but the affected end-to-end behavior is presentation/readability rather than independent proxy, connection, subscription, or settings business operations.
Behavioral complexity 🟡 Medium 🧩 Interacting branches

- Before: the sidebar was a fixed icon-only navigation surface with existing page-navigation and tooltip behavior. - After: the new module coordinates saved preference, wide versus narrow window mode, temporary overlay state, drag width/snap state, keyboard/context-menu toggles, resize transitions, and tooltip visibility. - New correctness condition: these state transitions must agree so a temporary narrow-window overlay does not overwrite the wide-window preference, and a drag/resize cannot leave width, expanded class, overlay class, or tooltip behavior inconsistent. - The CSS and i18n additions are supporting presentation changes, while the state interaction is newly introduced by sidebar.js.
Potential damage 🟢 Low 🩹 Reversible

- The plausible fault is an incorrect visual/navigation state rather than corrupted application data. - Restoring code or toggling the sidebar can recover the layout; a saved preference may need to be changed or localStorage cleared if the state is repeatedly restored incorrectly. - The app's page navigation handlers remain in place, so this does not establish capability loss beyond the shell's usability. - Revert restores the prior icon-only layout. - During activation, keyboard/context-menu toggling, resize, or clearing the zephyr.sidebar localStorage entry can recover the state. - No persistent business state or external effect is changed.
Assessed commit 8300edc
Diagram

```mermaid stateDiagram-v2 direction TD state "Wide expanded" as WideExpanded state "Wide collapsed" as WideCollapsed state "Narrow collapsed" as NarrowCollapsed state "Narrow overlay" as NarrowOverlay WideExpanded --> WideCollapsed: toggle or drag WideCollapsed --> WideExpanded: toggle or drag WideExpanded --> NarrowCollapsed: window narrows WideCollapsed --> NarrowCollapsed: window narrows NarrowCollapsed --> NarrowOverlay: toggle or drag NarrowOverlay --> NarrowCollapsed: dismiss or toggle NarrowCollapsed --> WideExpanded: widen; saved expanded NarrowCollapsed --> WideCollapsed: widen; saved collapsed NarrowOverlay --> WideExpanded: widen; saved expanded NarrowOverlay --> WideCollapsed: widen; saved collapsed ```
High-Level Assessment

>Keep sidebar interaction state in a small frontend controller while retaining the existing navigation and shared context-menu utility. CSS-only responsive collapse would not cover saved preferences, drag snapping, or temporary narrow-window expansion; a native or Rust implementation is unnecessary for these UI behaviors.
Files changed (10) +667 / -13

Enhancement (9) +556 / -13

Codecov provides highly integrated tools to group, merge, archive and compare coverage reports. Whether your team is comparing changes in a pull request or reviewing a single commit, Codecov will improve the code review workflow and quality.

## Code coverage done right.®

1. Upload coverage reports from your CI builds.
2. Codecov merges all builds and languages into one beautiful coherent report.

## What is [CodSpeed](https://codspeed.io)?
CodSpeed is a **continuous benchmarking** platform that allows you to **track** and **compare** the **performance** of your codebase during development.

It uses a smart **runtime engine** to measure the performance of your code in an **accurate** and **reproducible** way without creating a huge **runtime overhead**, unlike traditional benchmarks.

CodSpeed produces detailed **performance reports** helping you **improve** your codebase **performance**, directly **within your repository provider** (Pull Requests comments, Merge checks, ...).

## How it works

The core of the **performance measurement** is done directly within your **CI environment** through the **CodSpeed Action**. Allowing you to **stay the sole owner** of your data and to keep your **codebase private**.

Once the performance data is generated, **only the benchmark results** are sent to the CodSpeed servers to be **analyzed**.

Then, performance reports are **generated** and **published** directly **within your repository provider**.

## How long does it take to install?

If you're **already benchmarking** your codebase, you can plug your **existing benchmarks** to CodSpeed in **less than 5 minutes** since CodSpeed benchmark's API is **compatible** with the most **popular benchmarking frameworks**.

If **you haven't any benchmarks yet**, we provide an **intuitive** benchmarking API that allows you to **create your first benchmarks** in a **few minutes**.
